---
applyTo: ".ai/**/*.md"
---

Treat `AI_COLLABORATION.md` as the canonical protocol. Keep
`.ai/state/estado-dev.md` as an index and put detailed information in the
appropriate topic or task file. Do not store secrets, credentials, personal
data, absolute local paths, or raw chat transcripts in versioned memory.
Update `.ai/HANDOFF.md` when work is interrupted or completed.
